verdict.rationale: Mem0 Platform explicitly builds a native graph linking entities (people, places, concepts) automatically without external graph DB or schema, and documents entity-centric multi-hop queries like 'what do we know about Alice?' pulling facts across conversations. However, this is first-party docs only, with one community comment noting mem0's memory model is more key-value/semantic than true relational graph reasoning, and open-source graph memory setup/parity details are thin. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of multi-hop graph query accuracy, clarity on open-source graph memory parity vs platform-only, and benchmarks demonstrating relationship-based reasoning beyond marketing claims.
